title: Default-off, readiness-gated remote diagnostics
summary: Safety slice for #165: remote diagnostics cannot upload in shipping builds, even with stored consent. Future eligible beta builds additionally require explicit persisted revocable opt-in. Diagnostics shows unavailable/off status and keeps local history, export and clear independent. No implicit beta consent, local-history replay or ambiguous automatic retries. Offline queue and receiver-backed dedup remain open. Native and visual qualification UNRUN.
